crossRefs.note: Then they took Jeremiah and threw him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard.…
Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, “Take from here thirty men with you, and take up Jeremiah the…
For indeed, I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me…
They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.
I called on your name, Yahweh, out of the lowest dungeon.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: When Jeremiah had come into the dungeon house, and into the cells, and Jeremiah had remained there many days,
translations.bsb: So Jeremiah went into a cell in the dungeon and remained there a long time.
translations.kjv: When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon, and into the cabins, and Jeremiah had remained there many days;
translations.asv: When Jeremiah was come into the dungeon-house, and into the cells, and Jeremiah had remained there many days;
